title: LOAR 2.0
tagline: LOAR is an autonomous studio for original IP on chain in their own web3 Universes
description:
LOAR is a platform where creators deploy cinematic universes as smart contracts, generate AI video/image content, build branching narratives, and set up multiple revenue streams — all governed by token holders.

One-liner: "YouTube meets DAO meets AI studio" — creators own the IP, communities govern the canon, tokens capture the value.
how_its_made: LOAR is built as a modern full-stack web3 application, combining a React and Next.js frontend with a visual story editor powered by React Flow (or a similar node-based graph framework) to create branching narratives. The backend is handled through Node.js and Next.js API routes, while governance and ownership are managed through smart contracts on Base, an Ethereum Layer 2 network. Story content and media assets are stored using decentralized storage solutions such as IPFS, and users authenticate through wallet-based login providers like Privy, Dynamic, or RainbowKit. The platform likely relies on PostgreSQL or Supabase for structured application data, integrates AI-powered video generation APIs for content creation, and is deployed on Vercel alongside supporting blockchain infrastructure, enabling a scalable and decentralized storytelling ecosystem.
auto_summary: LOAR is a multi-app web3 platform for creating, governing, monetizing, and indexing collaborative story universes with smart contracts and AI tooling.
